raw.description:
About This Role:

The Content Marketing Strategist will own the planning, development, and execution of our content strategy that drives awareness and engagement with our brand. This role blends creativity with strategy: promoting our events, elevating our editorial voice, and showcasing our sponsors and partners in compelling ways. The right candidate for this role is equal parts storyteller, digital strategist, and data-driven marketer. Role is based on a 40 hour work week and salary is $2000-3000 USD per month based on experience.

Responsibilities:

  • Create and implement overarching content and strategies aligned with business goals to promote our content.
  • Help synthesize and distribute our extensive editorial content for the purpose of growing brand awareness.
  • Manage content calendars to ensure a consistent schedule of high-quality content across all social media platforms and maintain a unified brand voice and messaging.
  • Analyze content performance and metrics to refine strategy.
  • Develop and execute data-driven social media strategies, manage online communities, and stay updated on social media trends.

Requirements

  • Strong command of English language (written and verbal).
  • Must own a working laptop of a recent model and have full access to wifi of sufficient speed.
  • Candidates should have a strong academic background and a minimum of 3 years of full-time, professional post-graduation experience.
  • Proven experience in content strategy and content marketing.
  • Creativity in developing engaging content ideas and campaigns and experience using various social platforms to grow brand awareness.
  • Outstanding organizational and time management skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills

About From Day One:

The business landscape is changing fast. From Day One is a media outlet and conference series that helps companies navigate all that change in ways that put people first.

Since our beginning in 2018, we’ve reached over 150,000 attendees, hosted over a thousand speakers, and produced conferences in more than 20 major U.S. cities–and counting. We take a unique, cross-disciplinary approach, convening leaders in CSR, HR, marketing, and communications, as well as civic leaders, authors, and journalists, to share business strategies that benefit workers, customers, and communities.

We also publish reporting and opinion pieces by a network of notable journalists, led by the company’s editor in chief, veteran journalist Stephen Koepp.

At From Day One, we hire people who have a high degree of self-motivation and the potential to grow into active leaders. We call team members like these “drivers”. If you are a passenger, From Day One will not be a good fit for you.

As you apply, think about whether these attributes describe you:

  • You motivate and energize colleagues rather than waiting for inspiration.
  • You're relentlessly resourceful and take ownership rather than seeking excuses.
  • You look to consistently deliver great outcomes, and work to improve processes as you engage with them.
  • You are excited about your work and bring urgency to your mission.
  • You approach challenges with enthusiasm and optimism.

Our work is driven by our mission to improve the relationship between business and society, and our efforts are intended to contribute to a brighter future. By maintaining this optimistic outlook, we not only motivate ourselves but also uplift those around us. We believe that believing that the future will be better is the first step towards making it better -- for others, and for ourselves personally.

Please note that diversity and inclusion are absolutely core to our mission, and we are committed to those values in our hiring process.

Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Product Manager Sr. within PNC's Retail Product Management Development organization, you will be based remotely.This position may be eligible for remote work in select geographic locations, subject to approval by PNC. If approved, work must be conducted from a quiet, secure, and confidential home-based workspace. Occasional in-office participation may be required based on business needs.PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

  • Drives business and financial results through the selection, design, development and promotion of new and existing products or experiences utilizing traditional and emerging capabilities in technology, operations, and data analytics to offer customers a differentiated product experience.
  • Uses knowledge of emerging technologies to deliver products to customers through all applicable channels. Prioritizes and makes decisions regarding product recommendations. Develops business case, business plan and roll-out of specific products or experiences.
  • Monitors the marketplace to assess product, technology, and market trends to identify a market need or opportunity. Recommends new products or enhancements to existing products or experiences and develops and designs innovative features. Manages the development, production, roll-out, pricing or promotion of specific products, and recognizes, anticipates and resolves operational and process problems that arise.
  • Partners with key stakeholders including sales, marketing, digital channel delivery, and other internal service partners. Participates in client-facing and external stakeholder activities to ensure all product offerings or experiences meet strategic goals. Develops product-specific marketing initiatives. Supports risk management, compliance and audit needs as part of the first line of defense.
  • Drives business, financial and customer experience results of new and existing products and recommends modifications in product features and/or marketing to improve results.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

  • Customer Focused - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
  • Managing Risk - Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

Application Window

Benefits

PNC offers a comprehensive range of benefits to help meet your needs now and in the future. Depending on your eligibility, options for full-time employees include: medical/prescription drug coverage (with a Health Savings Account feature), dental and vision options; employee and spouse/child life insurance; short and long-term disability protection; 401(k) with PNC match, pension and stock purchase plans; dependent care reimbursement account; back-up child/elder care; adoption, surrogacy, and doula reimbursement; educational assistance, including select programs fully paid; a robust wellness program with financial incentives.In addition, PNC generally provides the following paid time off, depending on your eligibility: maternity and/or parental leave; up to 11 paid holidays each year; 9 occasional absence days each year, unless otherwise required by law; between 15 to 25 vacation days each year, depending on career level; and years of service.

raw.excerpt: Ralliant is seeking a Microsoft 365 Power Platform Engineer to design and deliver analytics solutions with a strong focus on Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and AI-enabled analytics strategy.
raw.description:
Ralliant is seeking a Microsoft 365 Power Platform Engineer to design and deliver analytics solutions with a strong focus on Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and AI-enabled analytics strategy. This role will play a key part in enabling AI-ready data foundations, supporting Copilot experiences, and operationalizing analytics and insights across the organization in a secure, governed, and scalable manner.

The ideal candidate combines strong BI engineering skills with an understanding of how AI capabilities (Copilot, semantic models, data quality, and governance) depend on well-designed data platforms. You will partner with business stakeholders, security, and platform teams to ensure data products are optimized not only for reporting, but also for AI-driven insights and automation.

Key Responsibilities

Microsoft Fabric & Data Platform Engineering
• Design and implement end-to-end Microsoft Fabric solutions leveraging Lakehouse/Warehouse, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, and Fabric capacities.
• Build scalable data ingestion, transformation, and modeling pipelines that support analytics, self-service BI, and downstream AI use cases.
• Implement standardized medallion-style data architectures (e.g., bronze/silver/gold) with strong data quality, lineage, and observability.
• Optimize Fabric workloads for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency, including capacity utilization and refresh strategies.
• Develop enterprise-grade Power BI semantic models designed for reuse, performance, and AI-readiness.
• Create and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards with a strong focus on usability, performance, and accessibility.
• Apply advanced DAX and Power Query (M) techniques to optimize large models and complex datasets.
• Implement and manage Power BI deployment pipelines, workspace strategies, and lifecycle management (dev/test/prod).
AI Strategy Enablement
• Design AI-ready data models and semantic layers that support Microsoft Copilot, natural language querying, and generative AI experiences.
• Partner with architecture and AI teams to align Fabric and Power BI assets with the organization’s broader AI and Copilot strategy.
• Ensure datasets are curated, documented, and governed to support trusted AI outputs (certified datasets, promoted models, consistent definitions).
• Identify opportunities to embed AI-driven insights into Power BI, Power Apps, and Microsoft 365 workflows.
• Contribute to enterprise standards for responsible AI enablement, including data quality, security boundaries, and explainability.
Power Platform & M365 Integration
• Build supporting Power Apps and Power Automate flows that extend analytics insights into operational workflows.
• Integrate solutions with Microsoft 365 services (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook) for collaboration, distribution, and automation.
Governance, Security & Operations
• Implement and maintain data security, access controls, and governance policies, including RLS, sensitivity labels, and workspace controls.
• Support Power BI and Fabric administration, including capacity monitoring, usage analysis, audit logs, and environment governance.
• Produce audit-ready documentation: solution architectures, semantic model definitions, AI usage considerations, and operational runbooks.
• Act as a trusted technical advisor to stakeholders during requirements gathering, solution design, and prioritization.

Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience delivering BI or analytics solutions using Power BI and Microsoft data platforms.
    • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, or strong prior experience with Power BI + Azure data services transitioning into Fabric.
    • Dimensional data modeling and semantic layer design
    • DAX optimization and performance tuning
    • Power Query (M) and data transformation best practices
    • Experience designing analytics solutions with AI and Copilot consumption in mind.
    • Solid understanding of data governance, security, and access control concepts.
    • Strong SQL skills for querying, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.

Discover a new kind of career in healthcare as a functional specialist.

Working in healthcare, and looking for a change? If you’re a nurse (RMN, RNLD, RGN), occupational therapist, physiotherapist or paramedic, you could use your skills in a different way as a functional specialist. At Capita Health Assessment Advisory Service (HAAS), we provide unbiased, comprehensive assessments for claimants of the Government’s disability allowance (Personal Independence Payment), over the phone, on a video call or in-person, either at one of our assessment centres or in claimants’ homes.

Our functional specialists write reports which help the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) make important decisions about a person’s health and care.
Maybe you’re a nurse right now and you’d like to move away from direct care - this role offers you the chance to not only improve your assessment skills, but also to use your knowledge and experience to make important clinical recommendations. Or you might be an occupational therapist, physiotherapist or paramedic wanting to learn how to evaluate situations in a different way in a different setting. We’re looking for people with the compassion and experience to understand our claimants’ health conditions/disabilities and how they impact their lives.

This role is different from other healthcare professions, and that’s why we take your training and development seriously. You’ll receive comprehensive training with time set aside for self-development learning.

If you’re looking for a change, including more regular working hours, a competitive salary and are ready to expand your skills and experience, this could be the role for you.

Job title:

Functional Specialist PIP - Wales

What you’ll be doing:

  • conducting initial reviews, paper-based, face-to-face, video or telephone assessments to evaluate how a claimant’s health condition or disability affects their day-to-day life
  • observing and reporting on an individual’s ability to carry out activities

HAAS is a new service that will bring together existing assessment services, for disabled people and people with health conditions, under a single provider in each geographical region. This will make accessing support simpler and easier for some of society’s most vulnerable people.

Capita will deliver assessments for Personal Independence Payment (PIP), Employment and Support Allowance (ESA) and Universal Credit (UC), as well as a number of specialist benefits including Child Disability Living Allowance (DLA) and Veterans UK assessments.

Capita has been delivering PIP assessments in the Midlands and Wales since 2013, and in Northern Ireland since 2016.

  • Access to the Headspace app for you and up to 5 family or friends
  • Access to our Employee Network Groups, which represent every strand of diversity and allow colleagues to connect and learn from each other on an open, inclusive platform.

You’ll get the chance to follow your chosen career path anywhere in Capita. You’ll be joining a network of experienced, innovative and dedicated individuals across multiple disciplines and sectors. There are countless opportunities to learn new skills and develop in your career, and we’ll provide the support you need to do just that. Our purpose is to create a better outcome for you.

We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means we’ll consider all suitably qualified applicants regardless of gender identity or expression, ethnic origin, nationality, religion or beliefs, age, sexual orientation, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Remote – U.S. & Canada Only | Part-Time or Full-Time | Summer 2026 Internship

Dates:

05/25/2026 - 08/14/2026

20-40 hours/week

Compensation:

$18/hour USD (U.S.-based candidates)

$18/hour CAD (Canada-based candidates)

Description

We’re not building an internship for observers. We’re building one for future teammates.

Level Agency’s Summer 2026 Internship Program is for high-potential early-career talent ready to do real work, own meaningful projects, and learn inside a high-performance agency environment.

This is not a “shadow and watch” internship. Our interns are accountable contributors who support real work, complete meaningful projects, and build toward full-time readiness.

You’ll join one department track, work over a structured 12 week program, complete a meaningful project with measurable impact, and receive direct mentorship from a dedicated go-to mentor.

A few important things to know up front:

  • You’ll select one internship track
  • The internship is expected to run during Summer 2026
  • The interview process includes two steps
  • Full-time conversion after the program is possible, but not guaranteed

This Isn’t for Everyone.

We’re building something rare: a place where growth, accountability, feedback, and performance all matter.

You’ll thrive here if:

✅ You want real ownership, not passive observation
✅ You move quickly, ask smart questions, and follow through
✅ You want feedback that helps you get better
✅ You care about doing work that has actual impact
✅ You’re excited by high standards and accountability

You’ll struggle here if:

❌ You want a low-accountability summer experience
❌ You need constant hand-holding to keep moving
❌ You want filler work instead of meaningful projects

❌ You avoid feedback or ownership

❌ You expect a full-time offer just for completing the internship

About Level

Good enough isn’t.

Level Agency is an AI-powered performance marketing agency built for brands ready to outperform yesterday’s results.

We help complex, high-consideration brands grow through AI, data science, creativity, and relentless iteration. Our work spans media, creative, SEO, AI search, CRM, analytics, and digital experience.

Today, our remote-first team supports ambitious brands across North America that expect measurable impact.

Your Role (and Impact)

As a Level Agency Intern, you’ll join one defined track and contribute as a working member of that team.

You’ll select one of the following tracks when you apply:

Media

Media is where strategy becomes performance in-market — turning budgets, platforms, audiences, and creative into measurable business results across channels like paid search, paid social, and programmatic. Support campaign execution, optimization, reporting, and performance analysis across channels. You may help with campaign builds, pacing, QA, reporting, and identifying opportunities to improve performance. This track is for people who want to learn how results are driven in-platform and through constant iteration.

Clients

Clients is the connective tissue between our teams and our client partnerships — helping ensure work is aligned, moving, and tied to business goals. Support account and client service teams across projects, communication, and deliverables. You may help manage timelines, organize next steps, support internal coordination, and keep priorities moving across teams. This track fits people who are organized, proactive, and energized by helping work move forward.

Creative

Creative is built to drive performance, not just look good — combining messaging, design, and testing to influence real business outcomes. Contribute to performance-focused creative work across ideation, production support, messaging, and iteration. You may help with asset development, copy support, concept exploration, and learning how creative testing connects to performance. This is for people who want to connect creative work to business impact.

Dev

Dev helps bring digital experiences to life — building and improving the web experiences that support conversion, usability, and growth. Support web and development initiatives that improve digital experiences and execution quality. You may help with site updates, QA, implementation support, and problem-solving across web experiences and digital builds. This track is for builders who like solving technical problems hands-on.

Martech & Analytics

Martech & Analytics turns data, systems, and measurement into clearer decisions and better performance. Support work related to data, tracking, reporting, measurement, and marketing technology. You may help with dashboard support, tracking validation, reporting workflows, and the systems that help teams measure what’s working. This track is ideal for analytical thinkers who enjoy systems and problem-solving.

Sales

Sales helps create growth before the work even begins — opening doors, building relationships, and shaping new opportunities for the agency. Support research, pipeline activity, outbound coordination, and sales process execution. You may help with prospect research, CRM hygiene, outbound support, and the work that keeps new business efforts organized and moving. This track is for resourceful people interested in how agency growth happens.

SEO

SEO is about helping brands earn visibility where people are actively searching for answers, solutions, and trust. Support search strategy through research, content support, optimization, and performance analysis. You may help with keyword research, content analysis, on-page recommendations, and identifying opportunities to improve organic visibility. This track is for people curious about how search visibility drives growth.

Strategy

Strategy connects insight to action — helping shape where brands should focus, how they should compete, and what will move performance forward. Support planning, insights, research, and cross-functional thinking that shapes client growth strategy. You may help synthesize research, organize insights, support planning work, and turn information into clearer recommendations. This track is ideal for strong thinkers who like connecting dots.

People Ops

People Ops helps build the team behind the work — supporting talent, culture, systems, and the employee experience that enables high performance. Support projects related to talent, culture, and team experience. You may help with people programs, documentation, coordination, and projects that improve how the team works and grows. This track is for people interested in how strong organizations and strong teams are built.

In this role, you will:

  • Contribute to real team priorities and deliverables
  • Own at least one meaningful project during the internship
  • Meet regularly with your mentor for feedback, coaching, and accountability
  • Track time weekly and stay responsive, organized, and reliable
  • Build toward full-time readiness through ownership, quality, communication, and learning agility

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S. or Canada
  • Availability for a part-time or full-time Summer 2026 internship (20-40 hours/week for 12 weeks)
  • Ability to work remotely with consistent responsiveness
  • Clear interest in one internship track
  • Strong organization, communication, and follow-through
  • Coachability and the ability to improve quickly based on feedback
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, high-expectation environment

Preferred

  • Prior internship, academic, freelance, volunteer, military, or project-based experience related to your chosen track
  • Familiarity with common workplace tools and platforms relevant to your area
  • Evidence of initiative, ownership, and self-direction
  • Interest in growing into a future full-time role

Full-Time Readiness

This internship is designed to help identify future full-time talent, but completion of the program does not automatically lead to a full-time role.

Interns considered for future opportunities will demonstrate strong ownership, reliability, quality, communication, learning agility, and alignment with Level’s values. Final full-time consideration would include an additional interview with the Department Lead and the President at the end of the program.

AI Expectations

At Level, AI is a core skill.

As an intern, you’ll be expected to use AI thoughtfully to learn faster, work smarter, and improve output. You should be open to experimenting with tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and role-specific AI tools where relevant.

You do not need to be an expert on day one. You do need to be curious, adaptable, and willing to learn.

Our Core Values

No Ego, All In

We win together.

Better Every Day

Feedback fuels growth.

Relentless for Results

Activity without impact is noise.

Driven by Truth

We make decisions based on data, not assumptions.

Benefits

What You’ll Get From the Program

  • Paid internship at a standardized U.S. and Canada rate
  • Structured mentorship and regular feedback
  • Real project ownership and hands-on experience
  • Exposure to a high-performance remote agency environment
  • Company-provided equipment during the internship
  • The opportunity to build portfolio-quality work and demonstrate full-time readiness

Please note: because this is a temporary part time internship program, standard full-time employee benefits may not apply.

Remote First

This internship is open to residents of the U.S. and Canada only.

It is fully remote, 20-40 hours per week.

We are unable to sponsor visas at this time.

Level Is Built on Inclusion

We are committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging.

Level is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome candidates from traditional and non-traditional backgrounds and celebrate what makes you, you.

Ready to Apply?

Apply through this posting and select the track that best matches your interests and strengths.

Our interview process is simple:

Step 1: Application review and Spark Hire one way video interview for selected candidates
Step 2: One live interview with the mentor and hiring team

If you want a summer of passive observation, this probably isn’t for you.

If you want to contribute, grow fast, and prove what you’re capable of, we’d love to hear from you.

Let’s build something together.

raw.description:
BlackCloak’s mission is to protect corporate executives and high-profile individuals in their personal lives, mitigating risks to their families, companies, reputation, and finances. We defend our clients’ digital lives from hackers, privacy leaks, and identity theft. If you are passionate about helping to protect others, then keep reading - this may be your next great opportunity.
As a Security Engineer, you will be part of BlackCloak’s internal technology team supporting corporate security, information technology operations, and compliance. This is a critical role that is both hands-on and strategic, influencing and driving success for BlackCloak and its clients by designing, deploying, and supporting technology solutions for all areas of the business.

What you will do

  • Application Security (Primary)
  • Champion application security program strategy and implementation, including but not limited to various controls towards a “shift-left” security model, Security Champions program, adoption and implementation of SAST, DAST, other application security tools.
  • Assist in maturation of the Secure SDLC, including threat modeling, security architecture and requirements guidance, as well as secure code development training.
  • Work directly with developers to triage findings, provide remediation guidance, and foster a security-first culture.
  • Manual testing support for light red teaming such as POC’ing vulnerabilities, leading penetration tests via vendor engagements and/or internally led testing, and validating security findings.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure Security (Secondary)
  • Partner with Engineering, DevOps, to secure GCP, AWS environments
  • Leverage Cloud Security tools such as CNAAP, to remediate discovered misconfigurations, vulnerabilities, and triage of Cloud Security alerts.
  • Develop and implement secure infrastructure baselines, vulnerability management processes, secrets managements, IAM, and hardening standards within the cloud environment.
  • Incorporation of shift-left security tests and controls, into CI/CD pipelines
  • Help expand monitoring capabilities within tools such as SIEM, CNAAP, including implementation of required cloud architecture/logging, onboarding of log sources to security tools, and detection rules for cloud-based threats
  • Zero Trust & Network Security (Support)
  • Strengthen Zero Trust posture by expanding usage of Cloudflare WARP, WAF, other Zero Trust tooling and principles
  • Collaborate with the IT team to enhance endpoint security policies within EDR tools such as SentinelOne, Crowdstrike, as well as secure hardening standards into MDM
  • Support design and implementation of IAM best practices/principles for workforce and client identity, leveraging tools such as; Google IDP, Okta, Auth0, Zitadel
  • Security Operations & Incident Response (Support)
  • Review, design, and implementation of new Security Tools - support administration across tools such as SIEM, EDR, CNAAP, Email Security, and others.
  • Support security and risk assessments for new tools, vendors, and relationships with broader Security and IT team.
  • Assist in development of new threat detections, playbooks, and automated response/remediation
  • Support triage and response of security alerts, as an escalation point from the broader team.
  • Participate in supporting security on-call rotation

What You Need to be Successful

  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience in a security engineering role, preferably within a cloud-native, startup environment
  • Experience building or contributing to a Secure SDLC program, leveraging application security tools, supporting security architecture reviews
  • Demonstrated experience securing public cloud environments, with a strong preference for Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience building or contributing to a Secure SDLC program.
  • Hands-on experience with modern security tooling, including
  • SAST/SCA: Snyk, Checkmarx, Veracode, or similar.
  • CNAPP: Wiz, Prisma Cloud, or similar.
  • EDR: SentinelOne, CrowdStrike, or similar.
  • SIEM: Google SecOps, Splunk, or other modern platforms.
  • A solid understanding of Zero Trust, IAM principles and practical experience implementing solutions with tools like Cloudflare.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, Bash) to automate security tasks and processes.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with both technical (Engineering) and non-technical (GTM) teams.
  • A proactive, "builder" mindset with a passion for improving processes, reducing risk.
    • Preferred Candidate will have:
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and its security implications (e.g., Terraform).
  • Knowledge of compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, GDPR, NIST CSF
  • Familiarity with common application development languages such as Java or JavaScript
  • Understanding of system and architecture design principles, from code to cloud
  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., GCLD, GCP Cloud Security Engineer, GCSA).

BlackCloak is an extremely fast-growing company in an entirely new product category. We have amazing product fit validated by industry awards and an impressive client base of Fortune 500 companies across all industries.

Join a high-impact digital health platform shaping global medical training
Cape Town / Remote | R30 000 – R40 000 p/m

About Our Client
Our client builds and maintains complex digital training platforms for global pharmaceutical organisations. Their systems support healthcare professionals worldwide and play a direct role in improving patient outcomes through high-quality, compliant education. They are known for working on large, mission-critical platforms with long-term roadmaps, offering developers the chance to deeply understand and shape mature codebases used across multiple international markets.

The Role: Mid-Level Ruby on Rails Developer
This role focuses on working under the hood of a large, established Ruby on Rails training ecosystem. The successful candidate will assess an existing, complex codebase to determine how it can be reused or adapted, then contribute to ongoing enhancements, maintenance, and feature development across multiple training products and regions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Minimum 3 years of experience working with Ruby on Rails

  • Analyse and understand a large and complex Ruby on Rails codebase

  • Assess the feasibility of working with or adapting existing systems for future needs

  • Contribute to updates, enhancements, and long-term maintenance tasks

  • Support multiple training courses with similar architectures but regional variations

  • Navigate country-level compliance differences beyond simple language localisation

  • Maintain and enhance large user databases and training records

  • Support certification logic linked to course completion and skill levels

  • Collaborate with stakeholders on an evolving backlog of technical tasks

About You

  • 3+ years of experience as a Ruby on Rails developer

  • Strong understanding of large-scale web application architecture

  • Experience maintaining and upgrading legacy codebases

  • Skilled in working with large datasets and relational databases

  • Comfortable handling complex business logic and compliance requirements

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to assess and adapt existing systems

  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work independently or in teams

  • Familiarity with version control and agile development processes

raw.description:
Our Company

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!

The Opportunity:

The Adobe Sign team is searching for a hardworking, proactive sales representative to drive success and active usage of Adobe’s Acrobat Sign solution within an existing customer base. To ensure at risk customers who purchased Acrobat, Acrobat Sign or Acrobat Services (otherwise known as DCE) are actively consuming and seeing value with the solution purchased. This role that will be focused on getting customers activated and successfully using DCE as soon as possible after purchase.

What You’ll Do:

  • Perform outbound contact / prospecting to existing high-risk customers to acquire net new business owners and define use cases for Acrobat Sign consumption.

  • Through prospecting efforts drive customer consumption / adoption of Adobe Acrobat Sign with goal of 90% or more usage by year 3.

  • Overcome barriers preventing high-risk customers from consuming Sign Transactions, Acrobat Services and or Acrobat purchased. Convert customer problems into solutions…

  • Acquire and maintain a working knowledge of the complete capabilities of Adobe Acrobat Sign service offerings.

  • Maintain an active pipeline of opportunities to meet monthly, quarterly and annual objectives.

  • Collaborate with various groups within Adobe (Product, CSM, Sales, Marketing, Finance and Engineering, etc.) to provide customer feedback and drive consumption within defined accounts.

  • Assist CSM to unlock accounts and find business owners through active prospecting for Acrobat Sign as needed.

  • Sales strategy - Will develop effective and specific customer strategies and plans to ensure consumption targets by high-risk account and territory are achieved.

  • Improve overall customer satisfaction in assigned accounts.

What you need to succeed:

  • Minimum 5+ years successful Enterprise Sales Experience.

  • Strong understanding and proven experience in selling SaaS-based technology.

  • Excellent communication and presentations skills with an outstanding customer first approach.

  • Demonstrated experience crafting account / territory plans to exceed goals.

  • Customer Acuity - experience assessing each customer's technology footprint, strategic growth plans, technology strategy and the competitive landscape.

  • Ability to forge and maintain business relationships.

  • Steadfast curiosity and knack for generating creative ideas to bring value to customers.

  • Ability to prospect within accounts to find business owners to champion Acrobat Sign consumption.

  • Demonstrated track record of exceeding sales targets.

  • Ability to work successfully in a collaborative environment, partnering closely with all other organizations within Adobe including Sales, CSM Organization, Renewals Team, Product & Marketing Teams.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several  U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. The U.S. pay range for this position is $135,200 -- $234,150 annually. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.In California, the pay range for this position is $161,700 - $234,150

At Adobe, for sales roles starting salaries are expressed as total target compensation (TTC = base + commission), and short-term incentives are in the form of sales commission plans. Non-sales roles starting salaries are expressed as base salary and short-term incentives are in the form of the Annual Incentive Plan (AIP).

In addition, certain roles may be eligible for long-term incentives in the form of a new hire equity award.

Our client, SplashEZ, a fast-growing eCommerce company, operating in the USA, is searching for a talented and experienced Amazon Account Manager to join their team for a full time remote job.

About the company

SplashEZ is an outdoor and recreational brand on a mission to create the most exciting, functional, and high-quality products in the market. From pool floats to premium boating accessories, we've made a splash with customers worldwide. As we continue to grow, were looking for an Amazon Brand Manager who is passionate about data, process, and creative problem solving to help us scale to new heights on Amazon.

About the Role

As an Amazon Account Manager, you'll take ownership of key aspects of the company's Amazon day-to-day operations. From monitoring daily performance, managing listings, tracking keyword performance, and launching promotions this is an all-encompassing role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly organized environment.
This is a hands-on role where attention to detail, strong communication, and Amazon-savvy are key.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Track account health, keyword rankings, and product indexing.
  • Stay on top of ClickUp tasks management, Slack, and email communications.
  • Handle Amazon support cases, including calls when needed.
  • Maintain keyword tracking and DataDive niche dives.
  • Create listings and use flat files for updates and catalog organization.
  • Optimize titles, bullets, backend search terms.
  • Upload new images, videos, and submit Brand Registry cases.
  • Submit refund requests.
  • Manage Lightning Deals, coupons, discounts, and Vine submissions.
  • Track the deal calendar, work with creators, and analyze results.
  • Maintain templates and send weekly performance reports.
  • Update keyword indexing and search volume.
  • Create and analyze A/B polls.

Qualifications:

  • 2+ years experience in the managing Amazon Seller Central accounts.
  • Knowledgeable about optimizing listings with measurable keyword ranking improvements.
  • Detail-oriented and analytical, with strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Fluent in tools like ClickUp, DataDive, Datarova, and Amazon flat files.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and highly reliable.
  • Comfortable working remotely and managing multiple workflows at once.
  • Comfortable working with Time Tracking software.

Our benefits

  • Work for a Market-proven, fast-growing company.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Supportive and friendly work environment.
  • Be a part of something bigger, where you can have autonomy over your work.
  • Fully remote work and flexible working hours (work from whatever place).

  • Collaborate with the executive team to develop operational strategies that align with the company's overall goals.
  • Analyze current operational processes and implement improvements to increase efficiency, quality, and cost-effectiveness.

  • Lead and mentor the operations team, ensuring alignment with company values, goals, and performance standards.

  • Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to track operational success and areas for improvement.
  • Maintain quality standards.

Talent Sourcer - Global Tech Recruitment

Join a fast-scaling global recruitment firm connecting top tech talent with high-growth companies across the Middle East

Remote South Africa | Middle East hours | £1200- £1300/month (R27 600 - R30 000)

About Our Client

Our client is a specialist recruitment firm headquartered in Dubai, focused on connecting top-tier talent with fast-growing companies across the GCC and wider Middle East. They work with venture-backed start-ups, scale-ups, and established tech-driven enterprises, with a global team and a high-performance, remote-first culture.

The Role: Talent Sourcer

This role exists to fuel the delivery of exceptional talent pipelines for high-demand tech and commercial roles across the GCC. You'll be sourcing globally for candidates such as Software Engineers, Product Managers, Data professionals, and more. Based remotely in South Africa, you'll collaborate closely with Consultants based in Dubai, leading sourcing strategies and candidate outreach in a fast-paced, international environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Minimum 4 years' experience sourcing or recruiting for technology roles (Software, Data, Product, Digital)
  • Source and engage high-quality candidates across global markets using LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, Stack Overflow, and other platforms
  • Screen candidates for technical skills, role fit, and motivation
  • Build and maintain talent pools for recurring technical roles
  • Map markets and competitors to identify talent trends and salary benchmarks
  • Collaborate with Consultants on search strategies, outreach campaigns, and shortlist reviews
  • Keep accurate data in ATS and sourcing trackers

About You

  • 4+ years of experience sourcing or recruiting for tech roles in an agency, RPO, or in-house environment
  • Strong understanding of sourcing strategy, Boolean search, and candidate engagement best practices
  • Skilled in using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing platforms
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Self-driven, organised, and able to work independently in a remote setup
  • Familiarity with the GCC/Middle East market, or strong willingness to learn
  • Previous experience sourcing across global regions is a strong advantage

raw.excerpt: Our secret to leading the way in hospitality?  We put our people first!
raw.description:
Our secret to leading the way in hospitality? We put our people first!

At Shake Shack, our mission is to Stand For Something Good in all that we do. From our teams to our neighborhoods, we're committed to always doing the right thing. As one of the fastest-growing hospitality brands, we're all about crafting unforgettable experiences for our guests. We offer endless learning opportunities and the chance to make a lasting impact on our business, restaurants, and communities. As a member of the #ShackFam, you’ll have access to hands-on mentorship, training, and growth potential, all in a fun and inclusive environment.

Join us and Be a Part of Something Good.

We Stand For Something Good
Our secret to leading the way in hospitality? We put our people first!

At Shake Shack, our mission is to Stand For Something Good in all that we do. You’ll learn lifelong skills and be empowered to make a positive impact—on our business, restaurants, and communities—all at one of the fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. From our teams to our neighborhoods, we’re committed to always doing the right thing.

Our teams are the core of what we do and what we stand for—supporting them is part of our DNA. We’ll provide you with learning and growth opportunities to set you up for success in your career. Sharing ideas, having fun, and working collaboratively isn’t just preached, it’s how we do things every day.

The Field Hourly Talent Acquisition Specialist is responsible for executing recruitment strategy and support for Team Member hiring at all Shacks across their designated support area. The TA Specialist will provide oversight of active Team Member requisitions and talent pipelines, serving as a Brand Ambassador within the region to engage future candidates with the Shake Shack employment brand. By flexing to support hiring managers as needed with recruitment and hiring processes, the TA Specialist plays a critical role in the Team Member hiring process from application to onboarding, ensuring an elevated experience at every step for both internal and external business partners.

The TA Specialist upholds our Company standards and values, while partnering with Shack hiring managers to build talented and diverse teams, demonstrating the ability to leverage all available resources to bridge gaps and balance the strength of their collective area. The TA Specialist is a collaborative and customer-service focused role that supports hiring managers in hiring top talent across all Team Member openings, while maintaining an efficient and effective hiring process.

**The ideal candidate will be based in CST or EST to support our business partners needs.**

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities

Recruitment Strategy & Hiring Process:

  • Support the Field Hourly Team Member staffing process by partnering with Shack hiring managers to ensure strong talent pipelines and efficient hiring processes

  • Proactively execute upon Team Member recruitment strategy, ensuring recruitment tactics utilized are customized to each Shack’s needs and pivoting tactics as needed

  • Develop proactive staffing processes and reporting to be able to proactively support hiring needs (time to fill, hires vs. terminations, candidate flow, and hiring trends).

  • Developing recruitment strategies and training to support hiring for new restaurant openings. Making sure each restaurant is staffed to their hiring par by targeted dates.

Employment Branding:

  • Support Shack hiring managers as needed with employment branding and recruitment efforts, local hiring events and career fairs, digital recruitment marketing and job postings, collateral and signage ordering, etc.

  • Serve as a key participant in the Shake Shack Brand Ambassador program, advocating for participation across the region and providing employment brand training as needed.

Resources & Tools:

  • Become SME of Applicant Tracking System and use Case Management system to provide a gold standard hiring process from a Hiring Manager perspective and a Candidate Experience perspective.

Skills & Knowledge

  • Managing Complex Business Decisions and Business Acumen

  • Dealing with Ambiguity

  • Self-Development and Growth

  • Organization and Delegation

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in human resources or related field

  • At least 2 years of Talent Acquisition related work experience, preferably in high volume recruitment

  • Prior experience supporting field locations, or a multi-unit region preferred

  • Prior Workday ATS experience preferred

Benefits at Shake Shack:

A work environment where you can come as you are, share your ideas, have fun, and work collaboratively:

  • Weekly Pay and Performance bonuses

  • Shake Shack Meal Discounts

  • Exclusive corporate discounts for travel, electronics, wellness, leisure activities and more

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance*

  • Employer Paid Life and Disability Insurance*

  • 401k Plan with Company Match*

  • Paid Time Off*

  • Paid Parental Leave*

  • Access to Employee Assistance Program on Day 1

  • Pre-Tax Commuter and Parking Benefits

  • Flexible Spending and Dependent Care Accounts*

  • Development and Growth Opportunities

*Eligibility criteria applies

Pay Range - $59,346.50 - $96,444.00 *The salary paid to a successful applicant will depend on the applicant’s experience, qualifications, business needs and resources, and the candidate’s location.

Click the "Apply" button above to apply for this opening.

About Us

Beginning as a hot dog cart in New York City’s Madison Square Park, Shake Shack was created by Danny Meyer, Founder and CEO of Union Square Hospitality Group and best-selling author of Setting the Table. Shack Fans lined up daily, making the cart a resounding success, and donating all proceeds back to the park beautification efforts. A permanent stand was eventually built…and the rest is Shack history! With our roots in fine dining and giving back to the community, we are committed to high quality food served with a high level of hospitality. Our team members enjoy a positive work environment that is deeply committed to the philosophy that we "Stand for Something Good."

NVIDIA is hiring senior engineers to develop its AI platform and more specifically its performance optimizations in deep learning frameworks using JAX, a tool that can differentiate between Python control code and NumPy code. You should have excellent communication and planning skills for this role. Come join us to build the next generation of tooling that will advance the numerical computing and machine learning research around the world!

What you will be doing:

  • Play meaningful role in NVIDIA's effort in contributing to JAX.

  • Design and implement JAX core components and drive peak performance on NVIDIA products.

  • Work with AI applied researchers and leaders to build future-proof models

  • Build tools that will increase the efficiency of teams developing AI-based systems.

  • Work to bridge the gap between the latest in numerical computing, simulation and deep learning research and their applications in real world products.

What we need to see:

  • BS in Computer Science or Computer Engineering or related field (or equivalent experience).

  • 6+ years relevant experience.

  • C/C++ and Python programming.

  • Experience with machine learning frameworks and their internals (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, etc.).

  • Proven ability developing customer-facing solutions, balancing feature requests and bugs.

  • Proven technical foundation in CPU and GPU architectures, numeric libraries, modular software design.

  • Highly motivated with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to work successfully with multi-functional teams, principles and architects. Coordinates effectively across organizational boundaries and geographies.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Understanding of JAX, Autograd, tracing, code generation and DSL compilers and their design.

  • Understanding of deep learning training in distributed contexts: multi-GPU, multi-node, synchronous vs asynchronous.

  • Background with software shipping cycles (dev, deploy, release, CI).

  • Experience building distributed systems and services at large scale.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. For Poland: The base salary range is 292,500 PLN - 507,000 PLN for Level 4, and 375,000 PLN - 650,000 PLN for Level 5.

职位概述

任职要求

  • 教育背景： 分子生物学、生物化学、细胞生物学、生物工程或相关专业硕士及以上学历。
  • 工作经验： 拥有3-5年及以上在知名生物科技公司、CRO或药企的研发、应用支持经验。

      1. 抗体新药开发: 如抗体库构建、人源化、亲和力成熟、序列优化。
      2. 细胞治疗: 如CAR结构设计、病毒载体构建、T细胞功能验证。
      3. 基因治疗: 如AAV基因组设计、sgRNA筛选、mRNA疫苗/LNP应用。
      4. AI在药物开发中的应用。
  • 实验技能：
    • 具备分子生物学和细胞生物学实验操作经验，包括但不限于：分子克隆、质粒构建、PCR、细胞培养、转染/转导。
    • 能够独立解决客户的技术问题。
  • 沟通能力：
    • 出色的中英文沟通能力（书面和口语），能够清晰、有逻辑地向不同背景的客户解释复杂技术概念。
    • 卓越的客户服务意识、主动性和解决问题的能力。
    • 优秀的团队协作精神和项目管理能力。

Job Overview

This position requires an expert with both a profound technical background and excellent communication skills. You will serve as a crucial bridge connecting the company's products with customer success, providing comprehensive and in-depth technical support for NGS panel design and synbio-related products to customers in China, both pre-sales and post-sales. You not only need to possess deep background in life sciences and knowledge of bioinformatics, but also be able to answer product questions, act as a trusted advisor for both basic research and industrial customers (encompassing antibody development, cell therapy, gene therapy and AI driven drug discovery), and solve practical problems through professional technical solutions to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty.

Core Responsibilities

NGS Panel Design

  • Efficiently fulfill NGS panel design requirements in China.
  • Actively participate in discussions with customers regarding special panel designs.
  • Maintain regular and effective communication with the global design team.

Technical Consultation and Support

  • Handle and respond to complex technical inquiries from customers about DNA synthesis products (genes, oligo pools, mutant libraries, etc.), providing professional, timely, and accurate solutions.
  • Gain a deep understanding of customer application scenarios in areas such as antibody drug discovery, cell therapy, and gene therapy, and offer research solutions based on the company's products.

Customer Relationship Management

  • Proactively follow up on R&D projects of key customers, establish and maintain strong technical trust relationships, and enhance customer satisfaction and product stickiness.
  • Collect, analyze, and provide feedback on customer needs and market trends to inform the company's product development and marketing strategies.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to participate in technical visits to important customers, provide professional technical demonstrations, and assist in achieving sales targets.
  • Work with R&D and production departments to thoroughly investigate and resolve complex technical issues raised by customers, driving continuous improvement in product quality and processes.

Job Requirements

  • Educational Background: Master's degree or higher in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Cell Biology, Bioengineering, or a related field.
  • Work Experience: 3-5 years or more of R&D or application support experience in renowned biotechnology companies, CROs, or pharmaceutical companies.

Professional Knowledge

  • Familiar with basic Linux operations and possess a certain foundation in bioinformatics.
  • Have a profound understanding of the principles, processes, and quality control points of oligonucleotide and gene synthesis technologies.
  • Be familiar with the applications of DNA synthesis products in at least two of the following areas:

1）Antibody Drug Development: Such as antibody library construction, humanization, affinity maturation, and sequence optimization.

2）Cell Therapy: Such as CAR structure design, viral vector construction, and T-cell functional validation.

3）Gene Therapy: Such as AAV genome design, sgRNA screening, and mRNA vaccine/LNP applications.

4）AI in Drug Discovery and Development.

Experimental Skills

  • Possess hands-on experience in molecular biology and cell biology experiments, including but not limited to molecular cloning, plasmid construction, PCR, cell culture, and transfection/transduction.
  • Be able to independently resolve customer technical issues.

Communication Skills

  • Excellent communication skills in both Chinese and English (written and oral), capable of clearly and logically explaining complex technical concepts to customers from diverse backgrounds.
  • Demonstrate exceptional customer service awareness, initiative, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Exhibit excellent teamwork spirit and project management skills.

About Twist Bioscience

Twist Bioscience synthesizes genes from scratch, known as “writing” DNA. Just as children learn to both read and write, the next phase of development for the genomics revolution is the ability to write DNA.

At Twist Bioscience, we work in service of people who are changing the world for the better. In fields such as health care, agriculture, industrial chemicals and data storage, our unique silicon-based DNA Synthesis Platform provides precision at a scale that is otherwise unavailable to our customers.

raw.description:
Teach English Online!

  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income
  • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing
  • Long-term employment only! (1 year+)

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation
  • Great communication skills
  • Commitment to responsibility
  • Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred
  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic
  • Bachelors degree
  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent
  • [REQUIRED] Fixed schedule for a minimum of 6 months

Our Application Process:

  1. Complete your online job application.
  2. Complete an initial set of video questions.
  3. Conduct a live demo lesson to showcase your skills.
  4. Sign a contract and start teaching!

Make good money, working from home with a flexible schedule.
We want teachers to give one-on-one online English lessons, in one-hour sessions.
Enthusiastic candidates who like working with kids are encouraged to apply. No teaching experience required.
We provide teachers with a state-of-the art lesson plan. Just bring your computer and headset, your energy, and we'll do the rest!

This is a part time, remote role.

Submit your application today!

Requirements

* Most US-based teachers work in the morning or on the weekends.
*Dependability.
*Good communication skills.
*An interest in teaching or working with children.
*Able to use a computer well enough to surf the web.
*High-speed internet connection.


Our mission at YiYi English is to provide the highest quality English lessons to eager students in China. Our teachers offer one-on-one lessons to children ages 5-15. We are looking for enthusiastic teachers to help our students achieve their educational goals. Our teachers work from home and connect with students online over video.

raw.description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.
We are looking for a skilled Compliance Rule Tuning Specialist to join our Transaction Monitoring team. This role centers on tuning and optimizing compliance rules that detect suspicious activities, ensuring they are accurate, efficient, and aligned with regulatory expectations. The ideal candidate will have strong SQL abilities, practical compliance knowledge, and experience building and refining transaction monitoring rules. They should have the expertise and communication skills to effectively challenge and persuade senior stakeholders, including MLROs, ensuring that compliance rules are both practical and operationally effective.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, refine, and optimize SQL-based transaction monitoring rules to detect suspicious or high-risk activities.
  • Design and build data tables and components that support robust rule frameworks, ensuring scalability and clarity.
  • Analyze alerts generated by rules to tune thresholds, reduce false positives, and maximize detection accuracy.
  • Collaborate with MLROs, compliance officers, and risk teams to understand requirements and translate them into effective, feasible monitoring rules.
  • Provide constructive feedback and persuasively engage senior stakeholders when rules or concepts proposed by MLROs are impractical or counterproductive.
  • Document rule logic, data sources, and tuning methodologies clearly to ensure audit readiness and facilitate team understanding.
  • Continuously monitor the performance of rule sets and adjust them to address emerging risks or regulatory changes.
  • Support ad hoc queries and reporting through advanced SQL scripting related to compliance investigations.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related discipline.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL with proven experience building complex queries and managing data structures.
  • Solid working knowledge of AML regulations, transaction monitoring concepts, and compliance requirements within crypto or financial services sectors.
  • Hands-on experience designing and tuning rule-based transaction monitoring systems, focusing on accuracy and operational efficiency.
  • Ability to confidently and diplomatically challenge and persuade senior stakeholders, including MLROs, to ensure rules are both compliant and operationally viable.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Experience working in fintech, crypto compliance, or financial services compliance environments is a strong advantage.

Why Binance

• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)
Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

Our Client, Nordzero, an international e-commerce company with a strong presence in the USA, Canada and Europe is looking for a highly skilled and experienced professional to fill an immediate opening for Amazon PPC Manager for a full-time remote job.

As the Amazon PPC Manager, you will be responsible for managing our advertising efforts on Amazon, setting performance goals, elaborating PPC strategies, and ensuring the successful execution of Amazon PPC campaigns to drive sales and maximize profitability.

If you have a strong background in Amazon PPC advertising, exceptional leadership skills, and a passion for driving success in the Ecommerce industry, we would love to hear from you.

About the Company:

At Nordzero we develop and sell products that help boost mood, well-being, beauty, and life quality every day. We want to create long-term added value for society. To ensure that our measures are effective, we set ourselves ambitious targets and measure our success. We actively strive to be more sustainable with all of our brands and products.

We are offering a modern working environment in a small company operating in a rapidly developing and international market. The collective is youthful and friendly, and many joint activities are undertaken together. You are offered the opportunity to approach your tasks creatively, generate new ideas and implement them.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive Amazon PPC strategies across our brands, to increase visibility, drive sales, and achieve KPIs
  • Conduct thorough keyword research and analysis to identify high-performing keywords and optimize campaigns for maximum ROI.
  • Monitor and optimize PPC campaigns, including bid management, budget allocation, A/B testing, and performance tracking to achieve optimal results.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Marketing and Product Development, to align PPC strategies with overall business goals and initiatives.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest trends, tools, and best practices in Amazon PPC advertising, sharing knowledge and implementing innovative strategies within the team.
  • Analyze data and generate actionable insights to improve campaign performance, conversion rates, and customer acquisition.
  • Prepare regular performance reports, highlighting key metrics, campaign results, and recommendations for further optimization.
  • Ensure compliance with Amazon's advertising policies and guidelines, staying informed about any changes or updates in the platform.

Requirements:

  • Minimum 3 years of proven experience in Amazon PPC advertising.
  • In-depth knowledge of Amazon PPC campaign management, including campaign types, targeting options, bid management, and keyword optimization.
  • Proven track record of successfully managing PPC budgets of over $50 and delivering strong ROI.
  • Expertise in using the Amazon Advertising platform, analytics tools, and data analysis techniques to measure and improve campaign performance.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to extract actionable insights from complex datasets
  • Strong understanding of keyword research, competitive analysis, and audience targeting in the context of Amazon PPC advertising.
  • Advanced skills in using Google Sheets or similar tools for data analysis and reporting.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and result-oriented, with a passion for continuous learning and keeping up-to-date with industry trends.

Our benefits:

  • Work for a Market-proven, fast-growing company.
  • Competitive salary and bonus opportunities.
  • Supportive work environment.
  • Friendly International start-up environment.
  • Paid trainings and courses.
  • Be a part of something bigger, where you can have autonomy over your work.
  • Fully remote work and flexible working hours (work from whatever place).

Job Summary

CDW Security is the business unit within CDW, Inc. built to help customers feel confident as they address security challenges and strive for impactful business outcomes. We maintain industry-leading expertise in the areas of strategy, risk, compliance, identity and access management, data privacy, secure infrastructure, and workforce development, to name a few. The products and services related to this expertise provide CDW clients everything needed to develop and mature effective security programs.

As part of the Security Solutions Executive team, you will be responsible for selling security services and products. The Security Solutions Executive is expected to enhance CDW Security’s presence, market share, and revenue growth in the cybersecurity market. Specifically, you will support the sales team with full sales lifecycle management through strategic account planning, research, opportunity management, relationship-building, partnering with services teams and OEM vendors, pursuit, and closure.

Your skilled experience will enable you to quickly embrace CDW Security’s integrated sales approach, demonstrating the ability to open and manage opportunities, related to:

  • Identity and Access Management, Security Program Development, Privacy, Risk and Compliance, Third-Party Risk Management, Threat and Vulnerability Management, Cyber Workforce Development, Cloud Security, Secure Infrastructure, Physical Security, Emerging Security Technologies

What you will do

  • Develop and execute successful strategies that expand CDW Security’s customer base and achieve bookings, revenue, and gross profit targets.
  • Establish a detailed, comprehensive understanding of all capabilities, service offerings, value proposition, market positioning, selling strategy and process, as well as key differentiators.
  • Cultivate productive relationships with key personnel in current and targeted accounts.
  • Identify, engage, qualify, develop, and earn new clients.
  • Manage, support, and grow relationships as part of the extended sales team with prospects and clients as a consultative seller.
  • Network with a broad range of client organizations and leadership in key fields, including: Information Technology, Information Security, Finance, Internal Audit, Data Privacy, Compliance, and Legal, Enterprise Risk Management, Procurement / Supply Chain Management
  • Proactively coordinate with other CDW Security resources to drive sales cycles, meet company objectives, and exceed client expectations. These key internal resources include Subject Matter Experts, Practice Leadership, Sales Management and Marketing.
  • Build strong relationships with the partner community to identify opportunities for CDW and those partners.
  • Understand industry landscapes and follow trends that impact our clients’ business risk, strategic decision-making, and budget planning and expenditure.
  • Provide accurate sales pipeline updates and forecasts.
  • Proactively populate and maintain all information in Salesforce.
  • Provide onboarding support and mentorship to entry level Security Solutions Executives.
  • Enhance CDW Security’s and your personal brand through participation at industry events, speaking engagements, blogging and other forms of acceptable public communication.
  • Proactively work with marketing to develop regional events that attract senior leadership from key accounts and prospects.

What we expect of you

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, or related technical degree or equivalent.
  • 10+ years of experience identifying opportunities and full lifecycle management for security services and products and/or equivalent experience as a security practitioner.
  • Mastery of at least seven of the security focus areas in the security portfolio
  • Experience with enterprise sales, with both strategic planning and day-to-day execution.
  • Proven performance record with demonstrated year-over-year metrics.
  • Successful record of meeting or exceeding sales goals.
  • Ability to take personal ownership of professional goals and achieve financial targets.
  • Strong ambition and sense of urgency.
  • Energetic networker and relationship-builder.
  • Ability to work with and effectively coordinate across extended internal teams and partners.
  • Excellent, professional written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to travel as needed for customer meetings and to develop/maintain partner relationships.

Pay range: $100,000 - $140,000, depending on experience and skill set
Annual bonus target of $30,000 subject to terms and conditions of plan

Additionally, uncapped commission subject to terms and conditions of plan
Benefits overview: https://cdw.benefit-info.com/

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization

We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.

Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

About Us

CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.

As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.

Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do. Together, we Make Amazing Happen.

raw.excerpt: Про нас:BetterMe — глобальна wellness-екосистема, що створює продукти для фізичного, ментального та емоційного балансу.
raw.description:
Про нас:

BetterMe — глобальна wellness-екосистема, що створює продукти для фізичного, ментального та емоційного балансу. Ми допомагаємо мільйонам людей ставати кращими — і зростаємо разом із ними.

Наразі шукаємо Junior 2D Motion Designer для створення яскравих анімаційних роликів для соцмереж. У команді ти навчишся працювати з анімацією та відео для різних платформ, освоїш інструменти та техніки Motion Design, матимеш можливість обмінюватися знаннями та отримувати зворотній зв’язок від колег.

За останній рік команда значно зросла, зараз у нашому Motion департаменті вже понад 30+ спеціалістів і ми продовжуємо активно розширюватися, відкриваючи можливості для навчання та професійного розвитку.

Твої майбутні задачі:

  • Працювати з готовими проєктами (колектами).
  • Створювати рекламні креативи за брифом.
  • Адаптувати відео під різні платформи та локалізації.

Що для цього тобі знадобиться?

  • Базові навички в motion-дизайні (комерційний досвід не обов’язковий).
  • Впевнений рівень володіння After Effects.
  • Розуміння монтажу й принципів роботи з увагою глядача.
  • Вміння працювати з текстом, кольором та композицією.
  • Pre-intermediate+ рівень володіння англійською мовою.
  • Уважність, здатність швидко навчатися та організувати свій робочий процес.

Буде круто, якщо ти:

  • Маєш досвід роботи з рекламою в соціальних мережах.
  • Працював/ла з розширеннями Animation Composer, Motion Tools, CompositeBrush та іншими.
  • Обізнаний/на в роботі нейромереж NanoBanana, Veo3, ElevenLabs та інші.
  • Знаєш як застосувати скрипти та експрешени у робот.

Що на тебе чекає в BetterMe:

Місія, що надихає. Кожен наш код, дизайн, ідея допомагають мільйонам людей ставати здоровішими і впевненішими.
Ком'юніті однодумців. Cередовище, де є підтримка, спільні обговорення, а конструктивний фідбек є нормою.
Обмін досвідом. Регулярні розбори кейсів, обговорення нових фішок в анімації та трендів.
Розвиток та навчання. Доступ до внутрішньої навчальних та професійних курсів.
Технічне забезпечення. Компенсація ПЗ, стоків та Аі сервісів.
Система менторства. Супровід досвідченого наставника на етапі адаптації.
Чіткий онбординг. Зрозумілі процеси введення в роботу, структуровані бази знань та ефективний старт.
Зручний формат роботи. Можливість працювати повністю віддалено.

Дізнайся більше про нас: Instagram, LinkedIn.

Job Title: .NET Developer (AI/LLM Experience)

About the Role

We’re looking for a skilled .NET Developer who is equally excited about building robust applications and exploring how AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) can transform the way we develop software and deliver value to our customers. You’ll work on modern .NET applications while also designing and implementing solutions that leverage AI/LLM technologies.

  • Design, develop, and maintain applications using .NET Core/.NET 6+.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with prompt engineering and designing AI workflows.

  • Interest in expåloring new AI tools and sharing learnings with the team.

  • Must be currently residing in the Philippines.
